profile.headline: Senior Software Engineer at Garmin International
profile.summary:
I have many years of experience in embedded software development in C/C++/Assembly.  My software experience spans from device driver code development to application level code development. Experienced in debugging/solving complex technical problems.

Specialties: Embedded Systems

C/C++/Assembly

Device drivers

Network processors

Low-level software debug

Initial hardware bring-up

VxWorks, IOS, Embedded Linux 

Networking software

positions.title: Member of Technical Staff
positions.description: Worked on Infiniband and iWarp Interconnects which provided high availability between pair of Netapp storage system

positions.title: Sr. Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Device driver code for DS3 line card and various Ethernet line card.
•	Develop control-plane code and data-plane code (microcode) for network processor 
•	Define and implement software API  for managing several FPGAs used in Hatteras products
•	Port third party Spanning Tree Protocol(STP) code to vxWorks operating system
•	Develop software that implements different specifications described in Metro Ethernet Forum(MEF)

positions.title: Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop firmware for OC-48 line card used in Edge Service Router (Cisco 10000 series). Develop and execute software unit testing of line card.
•	Provide software support for Packet-Over-SONET (POS) and Spatial Reuse Protocol (SRP) mode of operation. 
•	Made significant enhancement to IOS device driver code for the ASIC used for buffer management and interface to Cisco 10000 Series backplane.
•	Initial bring-up/verification  of Route Processor card for Edge Service Router(C10K)

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop device driver code, in C and C++, for 32-port Channelized T1/E1 Frame Relay Line Card, used in CBX 500 Multiservice WAN Switch. Develop and execute software unit test plan. 
•	Develop software functional and design specification for the channelized-OC12 card

positions.title: Staff Engineer
positions.description:
•	Develop and enhance router code used in IBM networking products. Worked on IP, ARP, spanning tree protocol, various bridging protocols (source route, transparent, translational ), SNMP MIB, Crash Dump Utility (for IBM routers). 
•	Develop multithreaded program in C++, for Thin server product, that performed caching of files from NFS server
•	Port Network Dispatcher feature, implemented in C/C++, from UNIX platform to embedded OS (multitasking  & POSIX compliant) 
•	Designed and verified an ASIC that performed layer 2 hardware switching between LAN and ATM. Design an arbiter and external SRAM interface in VHDL. Create portable tests in C that can be used in simulation verification and lab verification. 
•	Led verification effort of an ASIC used in the Token Ring and Ethernet LANs. Develop and execute simulation / lab verification plan.
